annotations.title: Housing costs for a census tract

description: Get tract-level housing-cost overlay (ACS 2020–2024 5-year): median gross rent, median home value, share of renters paying 30%+ of income on rent (rent-burdened), share paying 50%+ (severely rent-burdened), median household income. HUD's 30%+/50%+ thresholds are the standard cost-burden indicators used by VA-VASH, SSVF, and HUD housing-assistance programs. Use to qualify a veteran for housing aid, contextualize a service location, or find tracts with high rent burden. Accepts either FIPS codes or a resource_id.

resource_id.description: Alternative — look up housing context for the tract a resource sits in
